subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should the composer token meter preserve the current totalTokensFresh=false contract by hiding unknown context usage, or intentionally show stale usage as an updating state?
rationale: Current web, slash-command, and Android surfaces treat stale totals as unknown for context-utilization displays, while the related stale-indicator work proposes a different visible updating policy.

options.title: Preserve the freshness contract
options.body: Rebase and make the meter reuse the existing context view model so stale totals do not appear as live progress.

options.title: Show stale usage explicitly
options.body: Keep stale totals visible only if the UI labels or styles them as updating and adds tests for that policy.

options.title: Wait for stale-indicator alignment
options.body: Pause this PR until the overlapping stale context-indicator work settles the display contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve the freshness contract
recommendation.body: Rebase and make the meter reuse the existing context view model so stale totals do not appear as live progress.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored this PR and prior persistent web context usage work in the same UI surface.
